svg.title: Repository Essentials
svg.desc: A repository's root and .github folder hold the README, LICENSE, .gitignore, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, CODEOWNERS and dependabot.yml, grouped by what each one protects: people, legal terms, secrets, reviews and dependencies.
svg.text: Each file answers a question a contributor, lawyer or attacker would ask.
What it is, how to run it, how to contribute
How others may use and change it
Keeps .env, keys and build output out of commits
